proxy_url.title: Proxy base URL
proxy_url.description: Base URL of the claude-team-proxy. The same proxy the claude-team connector uses; invoices are reached through its /api/* passthrough.

proxy_auth_token.title: Proxy bearer token
proxy_auth_token.description: Shared bearer token the proxy expects.

claude_org_id.title: claude.ai organisation id
claude_org_id.description: UUID of the claude.ai organisation. Equals the Stripe customer id in the invoices path.

insight_source_id.title: Insight source id
insight_source_id.description: From the insight.cyberfabric.com/source-id annotation. Part of every unique_key.
